identifier_invariants.statement: the id never changes across versions, member changes or a direction flip
the id is not a function of the members
ids are never reused after retirement
retrieval accepts the id and only the id
a version names a state, the id names the object

mutation_invariants.statement: a mutation changes only the rows of the composite it names
atoms are immutable, so no member change alters a shared atom
retirement leaves a tombstone and never frees the id
the primitive never writes the frozen V1 graph

collision_rule: copy-on-write at the level of bindings: composites hold versioned references to immutable atoms

earning_test.prediction: members predict held-out edges better than the same atoms' pair counts
earning_test.control: intervening on one composite leaves a bystander composite unchanged
earning_test.decision: an interval including zero means the primitive is bookkeeping and the charter fails

open_questions: what normalisation makes rotated paths collide deterministically
how is the store compacted without changing a resolution
is registration cheap enough to run per detected structure

recommendations.question: members: atoms or carriers
recommendations.chosen: edges as members, tags as the key; homogeneous typed members; level 1 (atoms) built first, level 2 permitted but unbuilt
rejected: atoms only: makes a theory unrepresentable by schema
carriers only: no base case, multiplicative storage
tags as members: a tag triple with a missing edge would count as a carrier
recommendations.basis: the first experiment needs a stored V1 carrier, whose members are pairs and whose baseline is pair counts; homogeneity keeps effects attributable to a level

recommendations.question: canonicalisation for longer paths
recommendations.chosen: per-kind: sorted triple for cycle3, least rotation/reflection for cycle_n, preserve order for open paths
recommendations.basis: 177 paths over 158 node sets; a direction-free key must not merge two different node sets, and an ordered path may carry direction as meaning

recommendations.question: compaction without changing a resolution
recommendations.chosen: reference-count references; reclaim unreferenced atoms; never reclaim ids, keys or tombstones
recommendations.basis: atoms are immutable values rebuildable from the pair graph; ids and keys are the only non-reconstructible part

recommendations.question: registration cost and admission
recommendations.chosen: admit on total appearances m, not streaks; candidates carry no id
recommendations.basis: about eleven detections per cycle; direction flips would make a streak rule reject a stable object
